# Research Directory

Raw source material backing the claims in this knowledge base. Everything in the top-level `.md` files (desyncs.md, bluejay.md, am32.md, etc.) is the polished, cited output — this directory is the underlying evidence trail, kept so any claim can be independently checked against its actual source rather than taken on faith.

## Contents

* **`transcripts/`** — auto-generated YouTube caption transcripts (`.en.vtt`, raw) and cleaned/deduplicated versions (`.clean.txt`) for every video cited in [video-audio-knowledge.md](../video-audio-knowledge.md). See [TAKEDOWN.md](../TAKEDOWN.md) for the removal policy covering this specific subfolder.
* **`notes/`** — per-video extracted claims with timestamps, produced from the transcripts above. This is original analysis, not verbatim third-party content.
* **`hackmd-source.md`** — the original HackMD page this knowledge base was compiled from, downloaded verbatim.
* **`bluejay-wiki-setup.md`, `bluejay-wiki-migrating.md`, `bluejay-readme.md`** — copies of the Bluejay project's own public wiki pages and README, fetched to confirm exact wording before citing.
* **`humand-pasted/`** — user-provided screenshots and reference material (Discord messages, UI captures). **Not tracked by git** (see `.gitignore`) — this subfolder contains other people's messages and isn't meant for redistribution.

## Why this exists

A prior version of this knowledge base contained fabricated citations and unsourced numbers presented as fact. Keeping the raw source material alongside the finished documentation means any claim can be traced back to what a source actually says, not just what a citation implies it says.
